audit_insert.name: audit_insert
audit_insert.withCheck: "audit_events"."tenant_id" = (select app.current_tenant_id()) and ("audit_events"."actor_user_id" is null or "audit_events"."actor_user_id" = (select app.current_user_id()))

tenants_member_read.name: tenants_member_read
tenants_member_read.using:
(select app.current_tenant_id()) is null and exists (
        select 1 from memberships m
        where m.tenant_id = "tenants"."id" and m.user_id = (select app.current_user_id()) and m.status = 'active'
      )

users_read.name: users_read
users_read.using:
"users"."id" = (select app.current_user_id()) or exists (
        select 1 from memberships m
        where m.user_id = "users"."id" and m.tenant_id = (select app.current_tenant_id())
      )

products_price_currency_check.name: products_price_currency_check
products_price_currency_check.value: ("products"."reference_price" is null and "products"."currency" is null) or ("products"."reference_price" is not null and "products"."currency" is not null and "products"."reference_price" >= 0)

request_lines_delete_only_draft.name: request_lines_delete_only_draft
request_lines_delete_only_draft.using:
exists (
        select 1 from requests r
        where r.id = "request_lines"."request_id" and r.tenant_id = (select app.current_tenant_id()) and r.status = 'draft'
      )

approval_step_assignees_target_check.name: approval_step_assignees_target_check
approval_step_assignees_target_check.value: ("approval_step_assignees"."user_id" is not null) <> ("approval_step_assignees"."external_email" is not null)
